results.description:
I was supposed to be building bookshelves, not feelings.

And yet, here we are.

I'm finally making my dream come true—a cozy bookstore café in my hometown, where locals can sip lattes and get lost in paperbacks.

Too bad no one warned me how much construction is needed to turn an empty building into a coffee shop.

(Weeps in espresso beans.)

With my brother—aka my biggest hype man and only surviving family member--working overseas, I'm facing this challenge solo.

Enter Nick Warner—my brother's best friend and the town's resident bad boy. Despite his reputation, he's always been a cinnamon roll to me, and he has all the skills I need to fix up the building. Inconveniently, he's also the kind of guy I find incredibly attractive.

But he's a long-time friend, and I don't want to make things awkward between us, so I resolve to shove my feelings down deep.

I am totally capable of ignoring my attraction to him. Absolutely. If he would just stop being so irresistible!

I thought my biggest challenge would be keeping my business from failing before the grand opening. Unfortunately, it seems like my heart found a way to unlock an even bigger one: falling in love with my brother's best friend.

Bookstore Kisses & Small Town Wishes is a laugh-out-loud, small-town romantic comedy full of swoon-worthy moments, sizzling kisses, and cozy autumn vibes. It's a closed door romance with mild swearing/language.
